avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces cinacalcet plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal products

avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Opposing mechanism of action; calcium supplementation counteracts cinacalcet's phosphate-lowering effects
avoid_supplements.action: Use only if clinically necessary under physician supervision; monitor serum calcium and phosphate closely

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may increase cinacalcet levels; effect typically mild
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects (nausea, vomiting, hypocalcemia)

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May increase serum calcium, potentially reducing cinacalcet efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Coordinate supplementation with prescriber; monitor calcium and phosphate levels

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases cinacalcet bioavailability and plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Avoid consumption; switch to alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase cinacalcet absorption; food effect varies individually
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain consistent dietary pattern

caution_foods.name: Calcium-fortified foods (excessive intake)
caution_foods.mechanism: High dietary calcium may reduce cinacalcet therapeutic benefit
caution_foods.action: Maintain moderate, consistent calcium intake; avoid excessive fortified products

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum calcium, phosphate, and PTH levels regularly as cinacalcet's efficacy is highly individualized. Assess for hypocalcemia symptoms (paresthesias, muscle cramps, tetany) and adjust dose accordingly.
